source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (e)
text: the collection from another source would not prejudice the interests of the data subject;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (f)
text: collection of data from another source is necessary-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (i)
text: for the prevention, detection, investigation, prosecution and punishment of crime;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (ii)
text: for the enforcement of a law which imposes a pecuniary penalty; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (iii)
text: for the protection of the interests of the data subject or another person.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor shall collect, store or use personal data for a purpose which is lawful, specific and explicitly defined.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the rights of data subject specified under section 26;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the fact that personal data is being collected;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: the purpose for which the personal data is being collected;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: the third parties whose personal data has been or will be transferred to, including details of safeguards adopted;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (e)
text: the contacts of the data controller or data processor and on whether any other entity may receive the collected personal data;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (f)
text: a description of the technical and organizational security measures taken to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of the data;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (g)
text: the data being collected pursuant to any law and whether such collection is voluntary or mandatory; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (h)
text: the consequences if any, where the data subject fails to provide all or any part of the requested data.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor shall not process personal data, unless-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the data subject consents to the processing for one or more specified purposes; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the processing is necessary-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (i)
text: for the performance of a contract to which the data subject is a party or in order to take steps at the request of the data subject before entering into a contract;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (ii)
text: for compliance with any legal obligation to which the controller is subject;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (iii)
text: in order to protect the vital interests of the data subject or another natural person;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (iv)
text: for the performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (v)
text: the performance of any task carried out by a public authority;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (vi)
text: for the exercise, by any person in the public interest, of any other functions of a public nature;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (vii)
text: for the legitimate interests pursued by the data controller or data processor by a third party to whom the data is disclosed, except if the processing is unwarranted in any particular case having regard to the harm and prejudice to the rights and freedoms or legitimate interests of the data subject; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (viii)
text: for the purpose of historical, statistical, journalistic, literature and art or scientific research.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Further processing of personal data shall be in accordance with the purpose of collection.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller who contravenes the provisions of sub-section (1) commits an offence.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where a processing operation is likely to result in high risk to the rights and freedoms of a data subject, by virtue of its nature, scope, context and purposes, a data controller or data processor shall, prior to the processing, carry out a data protection impact assessment.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data protection impact assessment shall include the following-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and the purposes of the processing, including, where applicable, the legitimate interest pursued by the data controller or data processor;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: an assessment of the necessity and proportionality of the processing operations in relation to the purposes;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: an assessment of the risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: the measures envisaged to address the risks and the safeguards, security measures and mechanisms to ensure the protection of personal data and to demonstrate compliance with this Act, taking into account the rights, and legitimate interests of data subjects and other persons concerned.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The data controller or data processor shall consult the Data Commissioner prior to the processing if a data protection impact assessment prepared under this section indicates that the processing of the data would result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of a data subject.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: For the purposes of this section, a "data protection impact assessment" means an assessment of the impact of the envisaged processing operations on the protection of personal data.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The data impact assessment reports shall be submitted sixty days prior to the processing of data.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Data Commissioner shall set out guidelines for carrying out an impact assessment under this section.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor shall bear the burden of proof for establishing a data subject's consent to the processing of their personal data for a specified purpose.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Unless otherwise provided under this Act, a data subject shall have the right to withdraw consent at any time.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The withdrawal of consent under sub-section (2) shall not affect the lawfulness of processing based on prior consent before its withdrawal.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: In determining whether consent was freely given, account shall be taken of whether, among others, the performance of a contract, including the provision of a service, is conditional on consent to the processing of personal data that is not necessary for the performance of that contract.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Every data controller or data processor shall not process personal data relating to a child unless-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: consent is given by the child's parent or guardian; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the processing is in such a manner that protects and advances the rights and best interests of the child.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor shall incorporate appropriate mechanisms for age verification and consent in order to process personal data of a child.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Mechanisms contemplated under sub-section (2) shall be determined on the basis of-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: available technology;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: volume of personal data processed;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: proportion of such personal data likely to be that of a child;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: possibility of harm to a child arising out of processing of personal data; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (e)
text: such other factors as may be specified by the Data Commissioner.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor that exclusively provides counselling or child protection services to a child may not be required to obtain parental consent as set out under sub-section (1).
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor shall, at the request of a data subject, restrict the processing of personal data where-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: accuracy of the personal data is contested by the data subject, for a period enabling the data controller to verify the accuracy of the data;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: personal data is no longer required for the purpose of the processing, unless the data controller or data processor requires the personal data for the establishment, exercise or defence of a legal claim;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: processing is unlawful and the data subject opposes the erasure of the personal data and requests the restriction of their use instead; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: data subject has objected to the processing, pending verification as to whether the legitimate interests of the data controller or data processor overrides those of the data subject.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where processing of personal data is restricted under this section-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the personal data shall, unless the data is being stored, only be processed with the data subject's consent or for the establishment, exercise or defence of a legal claim, the protection of the rights of another person or for reasons of public interest; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the data controller shall inform the data subject before withdrawing the restriction on processing of the personal data.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The data controller or data processor shall implement mechanisms to ensure that time limits established for the rectification, erasure or restriction of processing of personal data, or for a periodic review of the need for the storage of the personal data, is observed.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Every data subject has a right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, which produces legal effects concerning or significantly affects the data subject.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Sub-section (1) shall not apply where the decision is-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: necessary for entering into, or performing, a contract between the data subject and a data controller;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: authorised by a law to which the data controller is subject and which lays down suitable measures to safeguard the data subject's rights, freedoms and legitimate interests; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: based on the data subject's consent.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where a data controller or data processor takes a decision, which produces legal effects or significantly affects the data subject based solely on automated processing-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the data controller or data processor must, as soon as reasonably practicable, notify the data subject in writing that a decision has been taken based solely on automated processing; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the data subject may, after a reasonable period of receipt of the notification, request the data controller or data processor to-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (i)
text: reconsider the decision; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (ii)
text: take a new decision that is not based solely on automated processing.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor, upon receipt of a request under sub-section (3), shall within a reasonable period of time-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: consider the request, including any information provided by the data subject that is relevant to it;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: comply with the request; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: by notice in writing inform the data subject of-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (i)
text: the steps taken to comply with the request; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (ii)
text: the outcome of complying with the request.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Cabinet Secretary may by Regulations make such further provision to provide suitable measures to safeguard a data subject's rights, freedoms and legitimate interests in connection with the taking of decisions based solely on automated processing.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A person shall not use, for commercial purposes, personal data obtained pursuant to the provisions of this Act unless the person-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: has sought and obtained express consent from a data subject; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: is authorised to do so under any written law and the data subject has been informed of such use when collecting the data from the data subject.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor that uses personal data for commercial purposes shall, where possible, anonymise the data in such a manner as to ensure that the data subject is no longer identifiable.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Cabinet Secretary, in consultation with the Data Commissioner, may prescribe practice guidelines for commercial use of personal data in accordance with this Act.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data subject has the right to receive personal data concerning them in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data subject has the right to transmit the data obtained under sub-section (1), to another data controller or data processor without any hindrance.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where technically possible, the data subject shall have the right to have the personal data transmitted directly from one data controller or processor to another.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where data controller or data processor declines to comply with a request under sub-section (3), the Data Commissioner may make a determination on the technical capacity of the data controller or data processor.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The right under this section shall not apply in circumstances where-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: processing may be necessary for the performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of an official authority; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: it may adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor shall comply with data portability requests, at reasonable cost and within a period of thirty days.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where the portability request is complex or numerous, the period under sub-section (6) may be extended for a further period as may be determined in consultation with the Data Commissioner.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor shall retain personal data only as long as may be reasonably necessary to satisfy the purpose for which it is processed unless the retention is-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: required or authorised by law;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: reasonably necessary for a lawful purpose;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: authorised or consented by the data subject; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: for historical, statistical, journalistic literature and art or research purposes.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor shall delete, erase, anonymise or pseudonymise personal data not necessary to be retained under sub-section (1) in a manner as may be specified at the expiry of the retention period.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data subject may request a data controller or data processor-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: to rectify without undue delay personal data in its possession or under its control that is inaccurate, out-dated, incomplete or misleading; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: to erase or destroy without undue delay personal data that the data controller or data processor is no longer authorised to retain, irrelevant, excessive or obtained unlawfully.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where the data controller has shared the personal data with a third party for processing purposes, the data controller or data processor shall take all reasonable steps to inform third parties processing such data, that the data subject has requested-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the rectification of such personal data in their possession or under their control that is inaccurate, out-dated, incomplete or misleading; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the erasure or destruction of such personal data that the data controller is no longer authorised to retain, irrelevant, excessive or obtained unlawfully.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where a data controller or data processor is required to rectify or erase personal data under sub-section (1), but the personal data is required for the purposes of evidence, the data controller or data processor shall, instead of erasing or rectifying, restrict its processing and inform the data subject within a reasonable time.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Every data controller or data processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures which are designed-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: to implement the data protection principles in an effective manner; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: to integrate necessary safeguards for that purpose into the processing.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The duty under subsection (1) applies both at the time of the determination of the means of processing the data and at the time of the processing.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures for ensuring that, by default, only personal data which is necessary for each specific purpose is processed, taking into consideration-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the amount of personal data collected;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the extent of its processing;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: the period of its storage;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: its accessibility; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (e)
text: the cost of processing data and the technologies and tools used.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: To give effect to this section, the data controller or data processor shall consider measures such as-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: to identify reasonably foreseeable internal and external risks to personal data under the person's possession or control;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: to establish and maintain appropriate safeguards against the identified risks;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: to the pseudonymisation and encryption of personal data;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: to the ability to restore the availability and access to personal data in a timely manner in the event of a physical or technical incident;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (e)
text: to verify that the safeguards are effectively implemented; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (f)
text: to ensure that the safeguards are continually updated in response to new risks or deficiencies.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: In determining the appropriate measures referred to in section 41, in particular, where the processing involves the transmission of data over an information and communication network, a data controller shall have regard to-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the state of technological development available;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the cost of implementing any of the security measures;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: the special risks that exist in the processing of the data; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: the nature of the data being processed.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where a data controller is using the services of a data processor-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the data controller shall opt for a data processor who provides sufficient guarantees in respect of organisational measures for the purpose of complying with section 41(1); and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the data controller and the data processor shall enter into a written contract which shall provide that the data processor shall act only on instructions received from the data controller and shall be bound by obligations of the data controller.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where a data processor processes personal data other than as instructed by the data controller, the data processor shall be deemed to be a data controller in respect of that processing.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor shall take all reasonable steps to ensure that any person employed by or acting under the authority of the data controller or data processor, complies with the relevant security measures.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where personal data has been accessed or acquired by an unauthorised person, and there is a real risk of harm to the data subject whose personal data has been subjected to the unauthorised access, a data controller shall-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: notify the Data Commissioner without delay, within seventy-two hours of becoming aware of such breach; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: subject to subsection (3), communicate to the data subject in writing within a reasonably practical period, unless the identity of the data subject cannot be established.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where the notification to the Data Commissioner is not made within seventy-two hours, the notification shall be accompanied by reasons for the delay.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where a data processor becomes aware of a personal data breach, the data processor shall notify the data controller without delay and where reasonably practicable, within forty-eight hours of becoming aware of such breach.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The data controller may delay or restrict communication referred to under subsection (1)(b) as necessary and proportionate for purposes of prevention, detection or investigation of an offence by the concerned relevant body.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The notification and communication referred to under subsection (1) shall provide sufficient information to allow the data subject to take protective measures against the potential consequences of the data breach, including-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: description of the nature of the data breach;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: description of the measures that the data controller or data processor intends to take or has taken to address the data breach;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: recommendation on the measures to be taken by the data subject to mitigate the adverse effects of the security compromise;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: where applicable, the identity of the unauthorised person who may have accessed or acquired the personal data; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (e)
text: the name and contact details of the data protection officer where applicable or other contact point from whom more information could be obtained.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The communication of a breach to the data subject shall not be required where the data controller or data processor has implemented appropriate security safeguards which may include encryption of affected personal data.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where and to the extent that it is not possible to provide all the information mentioned in subsection (5) at the same time, the information may be provided in phases without undue delay.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The data controller shall record the following information in relation to a personal data breach-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the facts relating to the breach;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: its effects; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: the remedial action taken.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the processing is carried out in the course of legitimate activities with appropriate safeguards by a foundation, association or any other not-for profit body with a political, philosophical, religious or trade union aim and on condition that-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (i)
text: the processing relates solely to the members of the body or to persons who have regular contact with it in connection with its purposes; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (ii)
text: the personal data is not disclosed outside that body without the consent of the data subject.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the processing relates to personal data which is manifestly made public by the data subject; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: processing is necessary-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (i)
text: the establishment, exercise or defence of a legal claim;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (ii)
text: the purpose of carrying out the obligations and exercising specific rights of the controller or of the data subject; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (iii)
text: protecting the vital interests of the data subject or another person where the data subject is physically or legally incapable of giving consent.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Personal data relating to the health of a data subject may only be processed-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: by or under the responsibility of a health care provider; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: by a person subject to the obligation of professional secrecy under any law.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The condition under subsection (1) is met if the processing-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: is necessary for reasons of public interest in the area of public health; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: is carried out by another person who in the circumstances owes a duty of confidentiality under any law.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Data Commissioner may prescribe further categories of personal data which may be classified as sensitive personal data.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where categories of personal data have been specified as sensitive personal data under subsection (1), the Data Commissioner may specify any further grounds on which such specified categories may be processed, having regard-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: to the risk of significant harm that may be caused to a data subject by the processing of such category of personal data;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: to the expectation of confidentiality attached to such category of personal data;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: to whether a significantly discernible class of data subjects may suffer significant harm from the processing of such category of personal data; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: to the adequacy of protection afforded by ordinary provisions applicable to personal data.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Data Commissioner may specify other categories of personal data, which may require additional safeguards or restrictions.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the data controller or data processor has given proof to the Data Commissioner on the appropriate safeguards with respect to the security and protection of the personal data;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the data controller or data processor has given proof to the Data Commissioner of the appropriate safeguards with respect to the security and protection of personal data, and the appropriate safeguards including jurisdictions with commensurate data protection laws;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: the transfer is necessary-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (i)
text: for the performance of a contract between the data subject and the data controller or data processor or implementation of pre-contractual measures taken at the data subject's request;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (ii)
text: for the conclusion or performance of a contract concluded in the interest of the data subject between the controller and another person;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (iii)
text: for any matter of public interest;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (iv)
text: for the establishment, exercise or defence of a legal claim;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (v)
text: in order to protect the vital interests of the data subject or of other persons, where the data subject is physically or legally incapable of giving consent; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (vi)
text: for the purpose of compelling legitimate interests pursued by the data controller or data processor which are not overridden by the interests, rights and freedoms of the data subjects.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The processing of sensitive personal data out of Kenya shall only be effected upon obtaining consent of a data subject and on obtaining confirmation of appropriate safeguards.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Data Commissioner may request a person who transfers data to another country to demonstrate the effectiveness of the security safeguards or the existence of compelling legitimate interests.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Data Commissioner may, in order to protect the rights and fundamental freedoms of data subjects, prohibit, suspend or subject the transfer to such conditions as may be determined.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Nothing in this Part shall exempt any data controller or data processor from complying with data protection principles relating to lawful processing, minimisation of collection, data quality, and adopting security safeguards to protect personal data.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The processing of personal data is exempt from the provisions of this Act if-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: it relates to processing of personal data by an individual in the course of a purely personal or household activity;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: if it is necessary for national security or public interest; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: disclosure is required by or under any written law or by an order of the court.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The principles of processing personal data shall not apply where-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: processing is undertaken by a person for the publication of a literary or artistic material;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: data controller reasonably believes that publication would be in the public interest; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: data controller reasonably believes that, in all the circumstances, compliance with the provision is incompatible with the special purposes.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Subsection (1)(b) shall only apply where it can be demonstrated that the processing is in compliance with any self-regulatory or issued code of ethics in practice and relevant to the publication in question.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Data Commissioner shall prepare a code of practice containing practical guidance in relation to the processing of personal data for purposes of Journalism, Literature and Art.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The further processing of personal data shall be compatible with the purpose of collection if the data is used for historical, statistical or research purposes and the data controller or data processor shall ensure that the further processing is carried out solely for such purposes and will not be published in an identifiable form.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The data controller or data processor shall take measures to establish appropriate safeguards against the records being used for any other purposes.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Personal data which is processed only for research purposes is exempt from the provisions of this Act if-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: data is processed in compliance with the relevant conditions; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: results of the research or resulting statistics are not made available in a form which identifies the data subject or any of them.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Data Commissioner shall prepare a code of practice containing practical guidance in relation to the processing of personal data for purposes of Research, History and Statistics.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Data Commissioner may issue a data sharing code which shall contain-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: practical guidance in relation to the sharing of personal data in accordance with the requirements of the data protection legislation; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: such other guidance as the Commissioner considers appropriate to promote good practice in the sharing of personal data.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The data sharing code under subsection (1) shall specify on the lawful exchange of personal data between government departments or public sector agencies.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data subject who is aggrieved by a decision of any person under this Act may lodge a complaint with the Data Commissioner in accordance with this Act.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A person who intends to lodge a complaint under this Act shall do so orally or in writing.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where a complaint made under subclause (1) is made orally, the Data Commissioner shall cause the complaint to be recorded in writing and the complaint shall be dealt with in accordance with such procedures as the Data Commissioner may prescribe.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A complaint lodged under subclause (1) shall contain such particulars as the Data Commissioner may prescribe.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A complaint made to the Data Commissioner shall be investigated and concluded within ninety days.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Data Commissioner may, for the purpose of the investigation of a complaint, order any person to-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: attend at a specified time and place for the purpose of being examined orally in relation to the complaint;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: produce such book, document, record or article as may be required with respect to any matter relevant to the investigation, which the person is not prevented by any other enactment from disclosing; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: furnish a statement in writing made under oath or on affirmation setting out all information which may be required under the notice.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where material to which an investigation relates consists of information stored in any mechanical or electronic device, the Data Commissioner may require the person named to produce or give access to it in a form in which it can be taken away and in which it is visible and legible.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A person who, without reasonable excuse, fails or refuses to comply with a notice, or who furnishes to the Data Commissioner any information which the person knows to be false or misleading, commits an offence.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Where the Data Commissioner is satisfied that a person has failed, or is failing, to comply with any provision of this Act, the Data Commissioner may serve an enforcement notice on that person requiring that person to take such steps and within such period as may be specified in the notice.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: An enforcement notice served under subsection (1) shall-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: specify the provision of this Act which has been, is being or is likely to be, contravened;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: specify the measures that shall be taken to remedy or eliminate the situation which makes it likely that a contravention will arise;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: specify a period which shall not be less than twenty-one days within which those measures shall be implemented; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: state any right of appeal.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Any person who, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with an enforcement notice commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding five million shillings or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding two years, or to both.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: obstructs or impedes the Data Commissioner in the exercise of their powers;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: fails to provide assistance or information requested by the Data Commissioner;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: refuses to allow the Data Commissioner to enter any premises or to take any person with them in the exercise of their functions;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: gives to the Data Commissioner any information which is false or misleading in any material aspect,
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: If the Data Commissioner is satisfied that a person has failed or is failing as described in section 58, the Data Commissioner may issue a penalty notice requiring the person to pay to the Office of the Data Commissioner an amount specified in the notice.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: In deciding whether to give a penalty notice to a person and determining the amount of the penalty, the Data Commissioner shall, so far as relevant, have regard-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: to the nature, gravity and duration of the failure;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: to the intentional or negligent character of the failure;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: to any action taken by the data controller or data processor to mitigate the damage or distress suffered by data subjects;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: to the degree of responsibility of the data controller or data processor, taking into account technical and organisational measures;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (e)
text: to any relevant previous failures by the data controller or data processor;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (f)
text: to the degree of co-operation with the Data Commissioner, in order to remedy the failure and mitigate the possible adverse effects of the failure;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (g)
text: to the categories of personal data affected by the failure;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (h)
text: to the manner in which the infringement became known to the Data Commissioner, including whether, and if so to what extent, the data controller or data processor notified the Data Commissioner of the failure;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (i)
text: to the extent to which the data controller or data processor has complied with previous enforcement notices or penalty notices;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (j)
text: to adherence to approved codes of conduct or certification mechanisms;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (k)
text: to any other aggravating or mitigating factor applicable to the case, including financial benefits gained, or losses avoided, as a result of the failure (whether directly or indirectly);
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (l)
text: to whether the penalty would be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A person who suffers damage by reason of a contravention of a requirement of this Act is entitled to compensation for that damage from the data controller or the data processor.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Subject to subsection (1)-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: a data controller involved in processing of personal data is liable for any damage caused by the processing; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: a data processor involved in processing of personal data is liable for damage caused by the processing only if the processor-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (i)
text: has not complied with an obligation under the Act specifically directed at data processors; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (ii)
text: has acted outside, or contrary to, the data controller's lawful instructions.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller or data processor is not liable in the manner specified in subsection (2) if the data controller or data processor proves that they are not in any way responsible for the event giving rise to the damage.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: In this section, "damage" includes financial loss and damage not involving financial loss, including distress.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: monies allocated by the National Assembly for purposes of the Office;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: any grants, gifts, donations or other endowments given to the Office; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: such funds as may vest in or accrue to the Office in the performance of its functions under this Act or any other written law.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: At least three months before the commencement of each financial year, the Data Commissioner shall cause to be prepared estimates of the revenue and expenditure of the Office for that year.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The annual estimates shall make provision for all the estimated expenditure of the Office for the financial year concerned and in particular shall provide for-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the payment of salaries, allowances and other charges in respect of the staff of the Office;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the payment of pensions, gratuities and other charges in respect of retirement benefits which are payable out of the finances of the Office;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: the acquisition, maintenance, repair and replacement of the equipment and other movable property of the Office;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: funding of training, research and development of activities of the Office;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (e)
text: the creation of such reserve funds to meet future or contingent liabilities or in respect of such other matters as the Data Commissioner may deem fit; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (f)
text: any other expenditure for the purposes of this Act.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The annual estimates shall be submitted to the Cabinet Secretary for tabling in the National Assembly.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Data Commissioner shall, within three months after the end of each financial year, prepare and submit to the Cabinet Secretary a report of the operations of the Office for the immediately preceding year.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Cabinet Secretary shall submit the annual report before the National Assembly within three months of receipt of the report under subsection (1).
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The annual report shall contain in respect of the year to which it relates-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the financial statements and description of activities of the Office;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: such other statistical information as the Data Commissioner may consider appropriate relating to the Data Commissioner's functions;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: the impact of the exercise of any of Data Commissioner's mandate or function;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: any impediments to the achievements of the object and purpose of this Act or any written law; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (e)
text: any other information relating to its functions that the Data Commissioner may consider necessary.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Cabinet Secretary may, make regulations generally for giving effect to this Act, and for prescribing anything required or necessary to be prescribed by or under this Act.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Without prejudice to the generality of subsection (1), regulations made under that subsection may provide for-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the requirements which are imposed on a data controller or data processor when processing personal data;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: mechanisms of conducting certification program;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: the contents which a notice or registration by a data controller or data processor should contain;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: information to be provided to a data subject and how such information shall be provided;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (e)
text: the levying of fees and taking of charges;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (f)
text: the measures to safeguard a data subject's rights, freedoms and legitimate interests;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (g)
text: the processing of data through a data server or data centre in Kenya;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (h)
text: issuing and approval of codes of practice and guidelines; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (i)
text: any other matter that the Cabinet Secretary may deem fit.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: For the purposes of Article 94(6) of the Constitution-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the purpose and objective of the delegation under this section is to enable the Cabinet Secretary to make regulations for better carrying into effect the provisions of this Act;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the authority of the Cabinet Secretary to make regulations under this Act will be limited to bringing into effect the provisions of this Act and fulfilment of the objectives specified under this section.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The principles and standards applicable to the delegated power referred to under this Act are those found in-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: the Statutory Instruments Act, 2013 (No. 23 of 2013);
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: the Interpretation and General Provisions Act (Cap. 2);
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: the general rules of international law as specified under Article 2(5) of the Constitution; and
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: any treaty and convention ratified by Kenya under Article 2(6) of the Constitution.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data controller who, without lawful excuse, discloses personal data in any manner that is incompatible with the purpose for which such data has been collected commits an offence.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A data processor who, without lawful excuse, discloses personal data processed by the data processor without the prior authority of the data controller commits an offence.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Subject to subsection (4), a person who-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: obtains access to personal data, or obtains any information constituting such data, without prior authority of the data controller or data processor by whom the data is kept; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: discloses personal data to third party, commit an offence.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: Subsection (3) shall not apply to a person who is an employee or agent of a data controller or data processor acting within the scope of such mandate.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A person who offers to sell personal data where such personal data has been obtained in breach of sub-section (1) commits an offence.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: For the purposes of subsection (5), an advertisement indicating that personal data is or may be for sale constitutes an offer to sell the personal data.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A person who commits an offence under this Act for which no specific penalty is provided or who otherwise contravenes this Act shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine not exceeding three million shillings or to an imprisonment term not exceeding ten years, or to both.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: In addition to any penalty referred to in sub-section (1), the Court may-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: order the forfeiture of any equipment or any article used or connected in any way with the commission of an offence; or
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: order or prohibit the doing of any act to stop a continuing contravention.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: The Data Commissioner may, for the purpose of this Act-
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (a)
text: issue guidelines or codes of practice for the data controllers, data processors and data protection officers;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (b)
text: offer data protection certification standards and data protection seals and marks in order to encourage compliance of processing operations with this Act;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (c)
text: require certification or adherence to code of practice by a third party;
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

label: (d)
text: develop sector specific guidelines in consultation with relevant stakeholders in areas such as health, financial services, education, social Protection and any other area as the Data Commissioner may determine.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf

text: A certification issued under this section shall not alter the responsibility of the data controller or data processor for compliance with this Act.
source_document: Kenya Data Protection Act (No. 24 of 2019) - KB 2/Africa/Kenya Data Protection Act.pdf
